timeconvert-notime:
Error message shown when the parser function or Lua library is called without a time. Parameters:
* $1 - The fallback time value.
timeconvert-nozone:
Error message shown when the parser function or Lua library is called without a time zone. Parameters:
* $1 - The fallback time zone name.
timeconvert-invalidtime: Error message shown when the parser function or Lua library is called with a time value that cannot be parsed.
timeconvert-invalidzone: Error message shown when the parser function or Lua library is called with an unknown or invalid time zone name.
timeconvert-timetable-too-many-rows:
Error message shown when the timetable parser function is called with too many date/time rows. Parameters:
* $1 - The maximum allowed number of rows.
timeconvert-timetable-too-many-zones:
Error message shown when the timetable parser function is called with too many output time zones. Parameters:
* $1 - The maximum allowed number of zones.
timeconvert-timetable-format-too-long:
Error message shown when the timetable parser function is called with an output format string that is too long. Parameters:
* $1 - The maximum allowed format length in characters.
